migration.replacement_gate: Per-rule App unit or no-UI interface coverage must fail under a named mutation and pass after restoration on every platform where the replacement compiles before matched E2E assertions retire; duplicate-removal batch #721 is separate from the unit-coverage PRs.
migration.reference_meaning: Existing replacement_tests are candidates, not coverage proof; an empty list means the exact replacement is not yet known.

smoke_flows.user_path: Select an album card; return to its summary and start playback.
Background the app and return to an operable playback page.
Submit an invalid public key; show a recoverable authorization error and remain on first boot without saving.
Enter URL and public key with the system keyboard; test, save and cold relaunch into playback.
Select a person without leaving the picker; return to the summary with the selection.
Start with synthetic PIN protection; reject a wrong PIN and unlock Settings with the correct PIN.
Reach configured random playback; pause, Next, Previous and resume through the real controls.
Change a representative playback setting through Settings; terminate and relaunch to read it back.
Background the iPad app and return to operable playback.
Enter and save public fixture credentials on iPad; cold relaunch into playback.
Reach playback on iPad; pause, Next, Previous and resume through the real controls.
Rotate once during playback; reach usable playback controls in the new orientation.
Open license details, return, reopen and switch another Settings sidebar destination.
Move focus between album cards; Select an album, return and start playback.
Press Home and return to playback with usable focus and remote actions.
Wake hidden controls with each direction and reach the operable Play/Pause focus target.
Use the remote and system keyboard to connect and save; cold launch with usable default focus.
Select to pause, move Next while paused, then use physical Play/Pause to resume; verify final control state.
Move through the person grid; select a person, use the Play/Pause solo shortcut and return.
Use the remote on the synthetic PIN sheet; reject a wrong PIN and unlock Settings with the correct PIN.
Reach configured playback, observe one eventual automatic scene advance, then use Next and Previous with the remote.
Save the second loopback server through real Settings; reach its lists and playback without old selections.
Change a playback setting with the remote; relaunch and verify its persisted state and Back navigation.
